title: Baa Juice Kiwi Passionfruit Guava 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Kiwi Passionfruit Guava Nic Salt brings three tropical favourites together in a smooth, exotic blend. Sharp Kiwi cuts through with bright tang, Passionfruit adds sweetness and depth, while mellow Guava rounds off the mix with juicy balance. Part of the Baa Juice Bar Salts range, this e-liquid is formulated with double-concentrated flavour for the kind of intensity associated with bar-style vapes. Blended at 50VG/50PG, it’s made for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) vaping, providing strong flavour delivery, discreet vapour, and a smooth throat hit. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Baa Juice Kiwi Passionfruit Guava Nic Salt is perfect for tropical fruit lovers using refillable pod kits and starter vape kits .
